entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I've had it for a couple of weeks and it's just not what I thought it would be. I want my money back.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It doesn't matter! I'm a VIP customer, I spend a lot of money here. I want to return it. This is supposed to be easy. Just process the return.
I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Mark. Pulling it up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 19 days ago. Sir, unfortunately, according to the updated return **policy** for our wearable sensors, we can't accept it back. It's **too late** to start a return.
What?! What do you mean it's 'too late'? Nineteen days? That's insane!

I understand it's frustrating. The reason for the strict timeframe is a matter of **hygiene**. For health and **sanitation** reasons, we cannot accept wearable electronics back after they've been used for an extended period.

This is completely unacceptable! Your website says 90 days! I want to speak to your manager right now! I'm going to post a review about this on every single website I can find. This is how you treat your VIP members? Unbelievable!

Sir, please let me just take one more look. I hear your frustration, and you are right to be upset if there's a discrepancy. Let me just double-check the policy as it applies to your specific item... one moment.

Okay... Sir, my sincerest apologies. I've made an error. I was looking at the new, stricter policy for our VeloBand *Pulse* monitors. You are absolutely correct. Your Cadence Sensor is a standard accessory and it falls under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh. So you *can* return it then?

Yes, absolutely. I am so sorry for the confusion. I can process this for you immediately. I've already generated a pre-paid return shipping label and sent it to your email. And for my mistake, and as a thank you for your loyalty as a VIP customer, I've also added a $25 credit to your account.
Wow, okay. A credit, too? Well... thank you, Alex. I appreciate you fixing that.
Of course. It was my error entirely. Your refund will be processed as soon as the item is received at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
